CustomField.description: Deterministic next-step guidance computed directly from Stage and Missing Documents.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Stage__c), "Draft", "Complete all required sections of your application and submit it before the cohort deadline.", "Submitted", "No immediate action required. Admissions is performing an initial completeness check.", "Documents Pending", "Upload your missing required documents: " & BLANKVALUE(Missing_Documents__c, "check your applicant checklist") & ".", "Interview Scheduled", "Attend your scheduled admissions interview and confirm your calendar invite.", "Under Final Review", "No action needed. Your file is with the Admissions Committee.", "Admitted", "Accept your admission offer and complete enrollment onboarding.", "Waitlisted", "Confirm whether you wish to remain on the waitlist for open seats in the upcoming cohort.", "Not Selected", "Review advisor feedback or schedule an admissions consultation to discuss eligibility for the next cohort.", "Contact Admissions Support for current status guidance." )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated next step for the applicant.
CustomField.label: Next Required Action
